name: Cloaked Fighting Style (Combat)
body:
You incorporate your cloak into your fighting style, using it to trap your enemy’s weapon.

Prerequisite: Greater Disarm, base attack bonus +9

Benefit: By draping your cloak over the arm of your off hand (which must be free), once per round, as an immediate action, you may make a disarm attempt when an adjacent opponent misses with a melee attack.

Special: You must be wearing a cloak and a have a free hand to use this feat.
